title: Normalized trace equals Fisher-whitened k-means
statement: d-tr(I_full^{-1}I_q)=E||z-E[z|Z]||^2 for z=I_full^{-1/2}s; maximizing retained normalized trace is weighted k-means.

proof_location.section: T1. Fisher-whitened normalized trace equals weighted k-means

warning: This control case is known in substance and is not a novelty claim.
